title: Citi® / AAdvantage® cardmembers and Lyft Credits
summary: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® cardmembers earn $15 in Lyft credit every month
body_markdown:
Good news for AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® cardmembers who ride with us: the Lyft credit you're already earning just got bigger.


Starting this month, Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® cardmembers earn $15 in Lyft credit every month — up from $10 — just by taking three eligible rides and paying with their eligible card. That's up to $180 a year, automatically applied to future rides. No new enrollment, no extra steps.


#### The perk you might not know you have


If you're a Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® cardmember linked to Lyft, there's a good chance you're already eligible — you just haven't unlocked it yet. Here's the quick version:


-


Ride 3 times in a calendar month, paying with your eligible card


-


Earn $15 in Lyft credit, automatically applied to your next ride


-


Repeat it monthly for up to $180 a year in credit


Set your card as your default payment method in the Lyft app, and you're in.


#### How to get started


1.


Update your Lyft app to the latest version


1.


Go to Payment in the app and set your eligible Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® as your default


1.


Take three qualifying rides this month


1.


Watch the credit land in your account — automatically


Not linked yet? Adding your card takes less than a minute, and the credit clock starts the same month.


*Terms apply. Valid on Lyft rides in the U.S. (including Puerto Rico). See full program terms in the Lyft app for details.*
